hooks.text: Many believed foreign warships in Smyrna harbor would save refugees.
Allied warships in Smyrna harbor watched the city burn without helping.
Why did Allied warships stand by as Smyrna burned in 1922?

title: Why Did Warships Watch Smyrna Burn in 1922? 🤯
description: In September 1922, the Great Fire of Smyrna destroyed the city's Christian quarters while foreign warships stood by under strict orders of neutrality.
